resolutions.researcher_notes: Possible other name for P0283, Creole Trail Pipeline. A discovery search found a pipeline called "Cheniere Southern Trail Pipeline" and judged it to be part of this row or another name for it. That is a judgment, and there is a chance it is a different pipeline, so check before accepting. Accepting adds the name to the other English names cell and changes nothing else. What the search found: Same project as P0283 Creole Trail Pipeline, Main Line. The EIA historical-projects sheet (Aug 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 512) lists Cheniere Southern Trail Pipeline, owner Cheniere Energy, 135 mi, 36 and 42 in, 2000 MMcf/d, LA/MS/AL, docket CP05-357, completed June 2008. CP05-357 is the Creole Trail Pipeline docket, per a Federal Register notice of 2005 and later FERC filings. The original proposal reached Mississippi and Alabama (open season, 348 mi proposed). Natural Gas Intelligence reported Creole Trail was scaled back. The built line is about 94 mi of 42 in, 1500 MMcf/d, in service 2008, from Sabine Pass LNG to DeQuincy, Louisiana. EIA appears to carry the earlier planned scope under an old project name. No new row. Possible note for P0283 only: other name Cheniere Southern Trail Pipeline. [QC] independent=yes claimed on 0 surviving ref(s) from 0 publisher(s) -> no.
